title: SentinelPR Real Finding Observation Schema
description: Schema for individual findings recorded during real repository validation, separating detection, ground truth, audited classification, and remediation.

commitSha.description: Commit SHA of the analyzed repository

ruleId.description: Security rule evaluated, e.g., SEC-001-FAIL-OPEN, SEC-005-SQLI

detectionStatus.description: Whether SentinelPR raised a finding for this construct

detectedSeverity.description: Reported severity if detected, or NONE

findingSnippet.description: Original code snippet flagged by SentinelPR

rawEngineFinding.description: Full verbatim finding object generated by SentinelPR engine

groundTruth.description: Independently verified real-world ground truth of the code

classification.description: Empirical audit classification. If groundTruth is UNKNOWN, classification must be UNCERTAIN.

classificationRationale.description: Detailed justification with file paths, dataflow analysis, and framework context

reviewer.description: Name or identifier of the engineer conducting the ground-truth audit

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when ground truth classification was finalized

remediationStage.description: Highest verified stage achieved by automated remediation

failureStage.description: Stage where remediation failed if FAILED

regressions.description: New warnings, syntax errors, or compiler breaks introduced
